import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from io import StringIO
from pymatgen.io.vasp import Poscar
from pymatgen.core import Element
# elemental polarizability A^3 approximate
pol={'Li':24.3,'Na':24.1,'K':43.4,'Rb':47.3,'Cs':59.4,'Be':5.6,'Mg':10.6,'Ca':22.8,'Sr':27.6,'Ba':39.7,'B':3.0,'Al':8.2,'Ga':8.1,'In':10.2,'Tl':7.6,'C':1.76,'Si':5.38,'Ge':6.07,'Sn':7.7,'Pb':6.8,'N':1.1,'P':3.63,'As':4.31,'Sb':5.0,'O':0.8,'S':2.9,'Se':3.8,'Te':5.5,'F':0.56,'Cl':2.18,'Br':3.05,'I':4.0,'Sc':17.8,'Y':22.7,'Zn':6.1,'Cd':7.2,'Hg':5.7,'Cu':6.1,'Ag':7.2,'Nb':15,'Ta':13,'W':11}
x=pd.read_csv('/work/nlo_pool.csv')
for _,r in x.iterrows():
 s=Poscar.from_str(r.poscar).structure
 M=np.zeros((3,3)); sw=0; nb=0
 # all near neighbors via covalent radii threshold; bond hetero only and χ difference mostly
 for i,site in enumerate(s):
  ei=site.specie
  ri=ei.atomic_radius or ei.average_ionic_radius
  for nn in s.get_neighbors(site,4.0):
   j=nn.index
   # unique bond counting based translated neighbor complicated simply half all
   if j==i and nn.nn_distance<.1:continue
   ej=nn.specie
   rj=ej.atomic_radius or ej.average_ionic_radius
   cutoff=float(ri+rj)+0.45
   if nn.nn_distance>cutoff:continue
   # downweight homopolar unless electroneg close structures like As
   de=abs((ei.X or 1)-(ej.X or 1))
   if ei==ej: chem=.25
   else: chem=.5+min(de,2)/2
   # anisotropy scales covalent species pol and shorter bonds
   w=chem*np.sqrt(pol.get(ei.symbol,5)*pol.get(ej.symbol,5))/nn.nn_distance**2
   v=np.array(nn.coords-site.coords); u=v/np.linalg.norm(v)
   M+=w*np.outer(u,u);sw+=w;nb+=1
 M/=2;sw/=2
 ev=np.linalg.eigvalsh(M)
 q=(ev[-1]-ev[0])/sw if sw else 0
 q2=np.std(ev)/(sw/3)
 print(r.candidate_id, f'{q:.4f}',f'{q2:.3f}',f'ev={ev/sw}',r.formula)
